dark:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create a finished, high-resolution editorial infographic for the TrackmaniaRL article explaining off-policy reinforcement learning. This REPLACES an unattractive plain-box flowchart. Make it visually sophisticated and extremely legible: precise flat graphic design, confident typography, generous negative space, subtle custom illustrations of road geometry, neural connections, a racing car and stacked experience records. Not a dashboard screenshot. No excessive decoration, gradients, neon glows, fake UI or unnecessary text. Landscape composition around 3:2, ideally at least 2400 pixels wide.

Dark palette: background #101713, slightly lighter panels #18221e, warm white lettering #e7eee9, muted pale lettering #adbbb2, mint #9ed5b9 for driving connections and soft blue #99c8ed for learning. Two visually clear horizontal zones, separated by whitespace. Top zone label exactly "DRIVING" with smaller subtitle "20 decisions per second". Bottom zone label exactly "LEARNING" with smaller subtitle "Reuse past experience". Use a compact top heading exactly "Drive now. Learn from experience."

Top zone has three equal editorial cards, in order left to right:
1 "Observation" with small telemetry/road icon and sublines "Car state" and "Road ahead".
2 "Policy" with a small neural network icon and sublines "Score actions" and "Choose controls".
3 "Trackmania" with a tasteful small illustrated racing car on a road and sublines "Apply controls" and "Advance the game".
Bottom zone has two cards:
" Learner" (render without the leading space), directly below Policy, with sublines "Compare prediction with target" and "Update network weights".
"Replay buffer", directly below Trackmania, with sublines "Store driving experience" and "Reuse past transitions".

These are the ONLY edges, and their directions must be unambiguous and scientifically correct:
A solid rightward arrow Observation -> Policy, small label "state".
A solid rightward arrow Policy -> Trackmania, small label "steering + pedals".
A solid return arrow Trackmania -> Observation, routed above the three cards without touching any text, labelled "next observation + reward". Its arrowhead MUST point into Observation, not out of Observation.
A downward arrow Trackmania -> Replay buffer, labelled "save transition".
A leftward arrow Replay buffer -> Learner, labelled "sample batches".
A dashed upward arrow Learner -> Policy, labelled "updated weights".
No extra arrows. No arrowheads on the wrong ends. No line crossing a card or a label. Rounded route corners and consistent line thickness. Place all labels comfortably in empty space.

Below the bottom cards, one concise exact note "A transition contains state, action, reward, next state and episode status."
All English text must be verbatim, cleanly typeset and readable at normal article width. No semicolons, no en dashes or em dashes, no comma before "and". Do not add algorithm performance claims. Do not add logos or trademarks beyond the word Trackmania. Illustrations should support reading, not compete with the information.

Edit this finished reinforcement learning infographic into an equally polished LIGHT-THEME counterpart for the same TrackmaniaRL article.
Preserve every word, every card, every illustration, the exact layout, all six connector routes, all six arrowhead directions and the image dimensions. Absolutely no content changes. Do not crop or reposition anything. Preserve the diagrams inside the Policy and Learner cards, the racing illustrations and the replay records.

Change only the palette and visual lighting of the infographic:
background a very pale warm neutral #fbfcfa.
The two zone bands subtly pale sage #eef3ed.
Card backgrounds white or nearly white, fine sage-gray borders #dbe2dc.
Title and node headings deep charcoal #202c27, secondary text #5f6c64.
Driving arrows and labels should be a clearly readable dark forest green #225541.
Learning arrows and labels should be dark steel blue #376d92.
Make all text highly legible on the light background.
Preserve all original internal illustration colors and geometry, with naturally adjusted bright surroundings. No new elements, extra labels, altered arrows or altered text. In particular the top return arrow goes from Trackmania INTO Observation, the bottom sample-batches arrow goes from Replay buffer INTO Learner and the dashed updated-weights arrow goes from Learner INTO Policy.
Render the same high-quality publication-ready image in the light palette.
